remarks: Prime Darien location offering easy access to the Noroton Heights train station, everyday shopping, and public beaches. This charming, older 3-bedroom, 2-full-bath Colonial blends classic character with practical modern updates. Interior features include high ceilings, central air, classic moldings, and hardwood floors throughout. The home has been updated with newly renovated bathrooms, refreshed bedrooms, and an eat-in kitchen fitted with new appliances and soft-close cabinetry. A spacious mudroom sits directly off the kitchen for convenient everyday storage. Exterior features include an inviting deck overlooking a private, level backyard. Detached one car garage and ample driveway parking.
